item.title: Version 1.6.0
item.changes: New: Filter › Volumetric Light. Haze that thickens with distance, using depth from a model trained for Compositor 16-bit and HDR layers keep their depth through 8-bit edits Hide/Show, clipping masks, number-key opacity and Convert to 16-Bit / 8-Bit work on every selected layer Right-click layers to export each as a trimmed PNG Space moves a Marquee while drawing, ⌘H hides the selection outline and guides, and the status bar shows the selection's size Edit panels open beside the canvas, where you last moved one, and painting is faster Fixed: Undo closing the image you opened, stray marching ants along the canvas edge, and Image Size scrubbing past limits
